lessons_learned: Bento template tests are pure data-transformation functions — no DI/DB/HTTP, no mocking needed. Each template needs 8-13 tests covering defaultTheme, toSlides counts, element types, data propagation, and edge cases (empty arrays, falsy values, many items).
UNSET Symbol pattern for 'omit this field' doesn't work with if(data.summary) checks — Symbols are truthy. Use empty string '' instead.
null coalescing (??) in test data builders makes passing null impossible — the builder always returns the default. For testing falsy behavior, use empty string or undefined.
Bento module now has 100% test coverage across both service (42 tests) and templates (67 tests) — 109 total.
Poetry annotation service now has 19 tests (no longer 0 coverage) — the lingxi-evolution skill's Phase Roadmap (Ph11) is stale and should be updated.
